model.title: Cahokia Mounds Mississippian Culture Study Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Richard Durbin (D-IL)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior to study three sites in Illinois, the Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site, the Emerald Mounds, and the Pulcher Mounds, to judge their national importance and whether they could become part of the National Park System. The study would also weigh other ways to protect and explain the sites, including through government or private and nonprofit groups, consult tribes and other interested parties, and estimate costs for each option. The Secretary would have to report the results, conclusions, and recommendations to Congress within three years after the study funds are first made available.
